description: Add the GCash verification modal HTML + JavaScript to templates/orders/order_list.html, and wire the Verify GCash button to open it instead of navigating away. After verify or reject succeeds, update the affected row in-place without a page reload. Depends on FEAT-001 (the gcash-details endpoint).
steps: CHANGE THE VERIFY GCASH BUTTON — In templates/orders/order_list.html, in the server-rendered Jinja2 table (the for Payment column, roughly line 423-431), replace the Verify GCash link with a `

CHANGE THE gcash_submitted SSE HANDLER — In templates/orders/order_list.html, in the RealtimeConnection.on('gcash_submitted', ...) handler (roughly line 838), replace the payCell.innerHTML anchor tag with the same button pattern: `payCell.innerHTML = \`\`;` — where detailApiUrl, verifyUrl, rejectUrl are constructed from the template URL pattern replacements like the existing payUrl/advanceUrl patterns.

CHANGE THE buildOrderCard MOBILE BUILDER — In templates/orders/order_list.html, in the buildOrderCard() function (roughly line 921), replace the Verify GCash payHtml anchor with the same button pattern: `payHtml = \`<button onclick="openGcashVerifyModal(${escHtml(d.orderId)}, '${escHtml(detailApiUrl)}', '${escHtml(verifyUrl)}', '${escHtml(rejectUrl)}')" class="btn btn-sm btn-primary">...</button>\`;` — construct the URLs using the existing pattern of replacing /0/ with the orderId in template-generated URL strings.

ADD MODAL HTML — In templates/orders/order_list.html, inside {% block content %} just before the closing `` of the page (or immediately after `{% include 'partials/payment_modal.html' %}`), add the GCash verification modal markup: ```html

Verify GCash Payment

Review the screenshot and confirm the payment is visible in the business GCash account before verifying. Do not verify if you have not checked.

ADD MODAL JAVASCRIPT — In templates/orders/order_list.html, inside {% block extra_js %} <script>, after the existing RealtimeConnection.on handlers and before the closing </script> tag, add the openGcashVerifyModal function and all modal logic. The function signature is: openGcashVerifyModal(orderId, detailApiUrl, verifyUrl, rejectUrl). Full behavior:

(a) OPEN: show modal-backdrop (display:flex), show loading state, hide content/error. Fetch GET detailApiUrl with credentials. On success, populate all modal fields (order number, customer name, amount, reference, submitted-at, screenshot img src + href). Show content, hide loading. Show gcash-om-footer-main. On fetch error or 400 response, show the error div and a close-only footer. During loading the Close button still works.

(b) CLOSE: hide backdrop, restore body.style.overflow, remove keydown listener, reset all state (_submitting=false, _verifying=false, _rejecting=false). Return focus to the triggering button (store reference in _triggerBtn).

(c) ESCAPE key support: addEventListener('keydown', onKey) on open, removeEventListener on close.

(d) BACKDROP click closes modal (if e.target === backdrop).

(e) VERIFY flow: clicking #gcash-om-verify-btn sets _verifying=true, disables both action buttons, shows loading spinner in button text. POST to verifyUrl with fetch + X-CSRFToken: getCookie('csrftoken'), Content-Type not set (no body needed). On success (data.success===true): close modal, showToast('GCash payment verified! Order is now Preparing.', 'success'), then updateRowAfterGcashVerify(orderId, data). On failure: re-enable buttons, show error in #gcash-om-action-error, keep modal open.

(f) REJECT flow: clicking #gcash-om-reject-start hides gcash-om-footer-main, shows gcash-om-reject-wrap (the textarea) and gcash-om-footer-reject. Clicking #gcash-om-reject-back reverses this. Clicking #gcash-om-reject-confirm sets _rejecting=true, disables reject-confirm button. POST to rejectUrl with FormData containing rejection_note textarea value, X-CSRFToken header. On success (data.success===true): close modal, showToast('Payment submission rejected. Customer has been notified.', 'info'), then updateRowAfterGcashReject(orderId). On failure: re-enable button, show error in #gcash-om-action-error, keep modal open.

(g) DUPLICATE SUBMISSION GUARD: if _submitting is true (either _verifying or _rejecting), ignore further clicks.

(h) Expose window.openGcashVerifyModal = openGcashVerifyModal so template inline onclick can call it.

ADD updateRowAfterGcashVerify — Still in the extra_js script: add function updateRowAfterGcashVerify(orderId, data). This function performs a direct DOM update WITHOUT waiting for SSE (SSE will also fire via the post_save status_changed signal, which is fine — the direct update and the SSE update must both be idempotent). Steps: (1) find row = document.querySelector(`tr[data-order-id="${orderId}"]`). If not found, return. (2) Update row.dataset: isPaid='true', status='preparing', statusDisplay=data.new_status_display||'Preparing', nextStatus='ready', gcashStatus='verified'. (3) Update Status column (row.cells[5]): set innerHTML to badge-preparing span. (4) Update Payment column (row.cells[6]): set innerHTML to 'Paid'. (5) Update Actions column (row.cells[row.cells.length-1]): rebuild to show print button + advance-to-ready button (following exact pattern from the existing status_changed SSE handler already in order_list.html). (6) Call window.initResponsiveTables && window.initResponsiveTables() and window.reinitLucide && window.reinitLucide().

ADD updateRowAfterGcashReject — Add function updateRowAfterGcashReject(orderId). Steps: (1) find row by orderId. If not found, return. (2) Update row.dataset: gcashStatus='rejected', status='awaiting_payment'. (3) Update Status column (row.cells[5]): set innerHTML to the GCash Rejected badge (background:#fee2e2;color:#991b1b). (4) Update Payment column (row.cells[6]): set innerHTML to a Pay button (cash fallback: ``) — this matches what the server would render for gcash_status='rejected'. (5) Call window.initResponsiveTables && window.initResponsiveTables() and window.reinitLucide && window.reinitLucide().

ADD GCASH-OM VERIFY-URL DATA ATTRIBUTES on the <tr> rows — In the server-rendered table, add data-gcash-verify-url and data-gcash-reject-url attributes to each <tr> so the mobile card builder and SSE handlers can reconstruct verify/reject URLs by orderId without needing extra URL template tags in JS strings. Add to the existing <tr> data-attributes: data-gcash-detail-url="{% url 'orders:gcash_payment_detail' order.pk %}" data-gcash-verify-url="{% url 'orders:verify_gcash_payment' order.pk %}" data-gcash-reject-url="{% url 'orders:reject_gcash_payment' order.pk %}". Also update the new_order SSE handler where it builds new rows: construct gcashDetailUrl, gcashVerifyUrl, gcashRejectUrl using the same /0/ → orderId replacement pattern already used for other URLs, and set row.dataset.gcashDetailUrl, row.dataset.gcashVerifyUrl, row.dataset.gcashRejectUrl.

UPDATE gcash_submitted SSE HANDLER — In the RealtimeConnection.on('gcash_submitted', ...) handler, replace the anchor payCell.innerHTML with a button that calls openGcashVerifyModal using the dataset URLs: `payCell.innerHTML = \`\`;`
UPDATE buildOrderCard MOBILE BUILDER — In the buildOrderCard() function, replace the Verify GCash anchor with a button using dataset URLs: `payHtml = \`\`;`
acceptance_criteria: Clicking 'Verify GCash' on any pending-GCash row opens the modal (does NOT navigate to order_detail).
Modal shows order number, customer name, total amount, reference (if present), submission date, and the payment screenshot.
Full-size screenshot link opens in a new tab.

Clicking 'Verify Payment' inside the modal POSTs to verify_gcash_payment, closes the modal on success, shows a success toast, and updates the row's payment badge to 'Paid' and status to 'Preparing' without a page reload.

Clicking 'Reject Payment' reveals the rejection textarea and 'Confirm Rejection' button; confirming POSTs to reject_gcash_payment, closes modal on success, updates the row's payment indicator to the rejected state.
Duplicate clicks are prevented during in-flight requests.
Errors (e.g. concurrent verify) are shown inside the modal without closing it.
Escape key and backdrop click close the modal when not submitting.
The modal renders correctly at 320px, 360px, 375px, 390px, 412px viewport widths (bottom-sheet on mobile via existing .modal-backdrop responsive CSS).
The existing Order Details page (order_detail.html) is unmodified and continues to work normally.
After verification, the SSE-driven status_changed event also arrives and is idempotently handled (no duplicate row or double badge).
After rejection, the gcash_submitted SSE flow (if triggered again) correctly shows the Verify GCash button (which now opens the modal).
python manage.py check reports no errors.
findings: All 8 steps implemented in templates/orders/order_list.html only. Pre-existing test failures (20 failures + 1 error) exist in apps/orders/tests_security.py (OrderRateLimitTests and TrackingTokenTests) and are unrelated to this feature — confirmed by running that test module against the baseline before applying changes. All 88 tests in apps/orders/tests pass (0 failures, 0 errors). The footer-main div uses inline style 'display:none' initially and JS switches it to 'flex' when content loads — this avoids the double-declaration issue seen in the FEAT-002 step spec (which used both display:none and display:flex in a single style attribute). The gcash_submitted SSE handler now also lazily constructs the gcash URL dataset attributes if they are missing on the row (e.g., for rows built before FEAT-002 JS was present), making the handler more robust.
